Look, I don't know, okay? I don't know!$b$bI just got paid to make rockets that deliver an airborne chemical payload, and that's what I did. Job's done, pal. They're all made, packaged, and sent off. I got the money and I was TRYING to enjoy myself a little when you started chasing me all over town.  I don't have any more of that chemical and I don't know what it was.
